name.value: Urad konzorcija za hrambo in presojo

description.value: Not a research institute at all, but it holds a seat and votes like one. Everything gathered under a restricted protocol is bonded here until a custodian, a consent and a reviewer can be got into the same decade. It knows precisely what it holds and, in nineteen catalogued cases, has no idea at all who is entitled to see it.
Urad, ki hrani gradivo, dokler ga eticna presoja ne sprosti.

notes.value: The office took over the staff and the unfinished obligations of a member institute dissolved in 2289. Two catalogue entries still require that institute's assent to close, and it cannot now be given by anybody.
